svg.text: SHEET 1 - PLAN VIEW (top surface) with base layout below, dashed
Island 69 x 96 in. North (top of page) is the table-saw side. Blade line, miter slots and outfeed grooves are aligned to the SawStop CNS with the 36" extension on the west.
SawStop CNS + 36" T-Glide (operator on this side, feeds south)
rear rail - bridge lip covers it
MOTOR BAY (recess in base, open to the saw)
two-sided platform on a 1" E-W axle at y = 22
fence line E-W, operator south; doors below open to flip
hood on the platform's north end (quick-connect hose)
SOUTH FACE - miter operator, long drawers, clamp rack
